title: Federal, state, local agencies search for missing pilot off Cape May Point, NJ
description: Crews across multiple agencies search for a pilot off Cape May Point, New Jersey, where the plane he was in was seen crashing into the ocean Wednesday, May 29, 2019. Coast Guard Station Cape May, Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City, New Jersey State Police, Cape May Fire Department, Cape May Police, local lifeguards and Sea Tow contributed to search efforts on land, air and sea. U.S. Coast Guard photo by Petty Officer 2nd Class Ryan Keegan.
